pitfalls.title: documentation_coverage_is_not_semantic_freshness
symptoms: Routing coverage passes while a plan or operational instruction still needs semantic review.
An unstaged Markdown fix hides a broken staged candidate.
Markdown links pass while plain-text filenames and source comments still point to retired documents.
Candidate documents use staged/commit content while routing helper code is imported from the worktree, allowing unstaged changes to alter the check.
A deleted or moved document disappears from affected_documents when its catalog entry is removed, so strict review can omit the retired path.
Raw pipe splitting treats escaped pipes in valid GFM plan cells as extra columns.
A per-heading-base counter collides with natural numbered headings and rejects valid links to globally suffixed anchors.
Removing a source/config/test route with its file or module can hide its document owner if only the candidate map is read.
Indented plan headers are recognized while raw row prefixes stop validation and allow invalid statuses or missing evidence.
The checker implementation is taken from the worktree even though its input and helper are read from the index or selected commit.
Default worktree path-only Git collection drops the source of staged renames.
Valid GFM plan rows omit edge pipes and bypass checks that require raw leading pipes.
A candidate checker raises SystemExit(0) before completing validation and the launcher reports success without a check report.
Worktree routing helper initialization can also raise SystemExit(0) outside the Git-candidate wrapper, skipping all checks.
trigger_actions: finish a code, config or documentation milestone
move or retire a document
close a plan or historical defect
check_before_edit: Use the scoped task diff; do not include other tasks in a shared dirty worktree.
Run document checks against the exact worktree, index or PR head candidate.
Treat source change as a review trigger, not proof that prose is wrong or that a plan is finished.
Close problems only with relevant current-version evidence; preserve historical evidence boundaries.

After moving or deleting documents, search tracked source and prose for retired paths and filenames; Markdown link validation does not cover plain-text or comment references. Check the actual Git candidate when the worktree is dirty.
Load reused routing helper code from the same candidate and include it in the review fingerprint; verify both outside-candidate failures and unstaged repairs with isolated Git fixtures.
Keep deleted managed Markdown paths in the review scope independently of the current catalog; require a decision about replacement contracts, routing and source references.
Split plan cells on unescaped GFM table delimiters; pipes inside inline code must also be escaped. Cover worktree, staged, commit and rename retirement cases.
Generate heading suffixes against every previously emitted heading slug, including naturally numbered headings; test both heading orders and actual inbound links.
Resolve changed paths against both candidate and base module/document ownership; use HEAD for worktree/index and merge-base for PRs, and bind the base commit in review fingerprints.
Normalize plan row indentation consistently with headers after excluding code blocks; cover legal one-to-three-space indentation with invalid states and missing evidence.

Run Git-candidate validation in the checker implementation selected from that candidate and bind its bytes in the fingerprint; missing, invalid or failed candidate code must not fall back to worktree repairs.
Use structured name-status diffs for both staged and unstaged worktree changes, retaining both rename paths and separately including untracked paths.
Recognize plan header labels and rows with optional GFM edge pipes while retaining column, state and evidence checks.
Convert SystemExit during candidate checker initialization or main execution into failure, including a zero exit code; verify staged and commit candidates with both entry points.
Catch SystemExit at the helper import boundary for worktree, staged and commit checks, and remove partially loaded helper modules on failure.

pitfalls.title: workbench_shell_registry_keys_overlay_layer_and_table_semantics
symptoms: A registry-derived list keeps stale rows after filtering: two stages publish the same accounting route under different labels, so a path-only React key collides.
An overlay rendered inside the sticky header paints below page-level drawers, which already claim z-[110] to z-[200].
Several tables on one page are announced only as "table 1/2/3" because neither a caption nor an aria-label is present.
A loading state replaces the whole block with one line of text, so the layout jumps when data arrives.
The pre-investment overview can mislabel the last browser bookmark as the current research and show unrelated completed steps before the user selects a study.
trigger_actions: add, reorder or cross-list entries in processRegistry
add a global overlay, dialog or command surface to the workbench shell
add a business table or migrate one to the shared primitive
check_before_edit: processRegistry paths are not unique: the two fund-accounting workspaces are cross-listed from another stage with different labels. Key registry-derived lists by stage plus path, and keep both rows so either name finds the page.

The header is position:sticky with its own z-index, so it forms a stacking context. Render global overlays through createPortal to document.body; a z-index inside the header cannot beat a page drawer.

Tables need a caption or an aria-label. The unnamed-tables budget in check_frontend_design.mjs is a ratchet locked at the measured value and may only go down; writing a table tag inside a comment also counts.
Loading states keep the final shape. Use the Skeleton and DataTable primitives in components/ui.tsx rather than replacing a block with a line of text.

StageLayout must hide the current-research badge, allocation progress bar and resume prompt on the pre-investment overview, including trailing slash/query variants. Preserve stored studies and drafts; directory links stay identity-free. Verify overview-to-module and return navigation, and keep selected-study behavior covered in StageLayout.test.tsx and process-framework.spec.ts.

The pre-investment overview groups registered nodes into three workflow phases; resolve names, numbers and links from processRegistry, and never turn the static guide into selected-study progress. Keep confirmed LTCMA before SAA, mark TAA optional, and explain direct SAA-to-product handoff. Preserve naked directory URLs and bookmarks. Verify keyboard details expansion, Chinese/English long labels, reduced motion, contrast and 320/768/1440px layouts.

pitfalls.title: allocation_journey_step_gates_must_match_real_destinations_and_inpage_selection
symptoms: A flow step is lit and clickable, but allocationJourneyPath rewrites it to a different step, so the click lands on the previous page.
Gating the SAA step on a selected LTCMA deadlocks the chain: the LTCMA is chosen inside the SAA policy page itself (its second wizard step), so the gate blocks the only way to satisfy it.

A previously selected LTCMA or baseline stays in the journey after the mandate, product range, allocation, strategic universe or implementation mapping changes, and the page then loads an assumption the server will reject.
A step state stored in sessionStorage/localStorage is read as proof of eligibility; another browser or a cleared cache shows a different chain while the saved artifacts are unchanged.
A page reads params.get(x) ?? journey.x, so the same URL shows a different selection per browser or tab and the user cannot tell what is selected or when it was chosen.

The page renders nothing selected because the URL carries no identity, yet the flow bar still marks the step done and unlocks the next one, because StageLayout ready/done read allocationJourney instead of the address bar.
trigger_actions: add or re-gate a step in the StageLayout allocation flow bar
add a new identity field to AllocationJourney or change its cascade
change allocationJourneyPath destinations or query identity
move a selection between the standalone centre page and the workspace that consumes it
read an identity (mandate, universe, strategic_universe, mapping, version, alloc, cma, baseline, decision, view) on a pre-investment page
change how the StageLayout flow bar derives ready, done or its step links
blast_radius: perceived eligibility of a saved policy
check_before_edit: A step's ready must agree with its real destination. allocationJourneyPath redirects the products step back to TAA when no handoff draft exists; both sides read productsHandoffReady so a lit step always lands where it says.

Do not gate a step on state that is chosen inside that same step. LtcmaSelection lives in the SAA policy page, so SAA ready stays on scope readiness; the LTCMA gate is enforced server-side by preview_policy (SAA_MANDATE_CMA_BASIS, SAA_MANDATE_EXPIRED, SAA_CMA_SOURCE_CHANGED).

Any new upstream identity must be added to the journeyFrom whitelist and to the cascade in updateAllocationJourney, or a stale reference outlives the scope change that invalidated it. CMA_SCOPE_KEYS lists the identities an LTCMA is bound to.

The flow bar is guidance, not authorization. Journey state is per-browser; the authoritative checks are preview_policy and policy_gate.require_policy_application, and in-page blockers such as mandateBlockedReason.

Identities come from the URL only; allocationJourney is a bookmark. Never fall back to journey.x for an identity, and never let navigation write the journey: updateAllocationJourney cascades, so writing mandateId: undefined on a bare-URL page deletes ltcmaId, baselineId and taaRunId. Resume is offered explicitly by ResumeResearch. Only date defaults (researchDate, endDate), the portfolioResearchImport handoff payload, and save-time write-preserve keep reading the journey.

The flow bar must share the page's source of truth. StageLayout computes bookmarkSteps from the journey, then marks the bar detached when the current page is a pre-investment flow step whose URL carries none of RESUME_IDENTITY_KEYS (LTCMA carries its identity in /ltcma/:id); a detached bar renders as not started, builds its links from an empty journey and shows the research header as unselected. Overview, tool pages and /product-research/pools stay bookmark annotations.
safe_observation_methods: Render StageLayout at a bare flow-step URL with a populated allocation-journey:v1 and assert the next step is a blocked span, not a link; fixtures that write identity only into the journey are stale under this contract.

pitfalls.title: daily_return_alignment_uses_common_adjacent_periods_not_full_sse_coverage
symptoms: Scope screening stays 暂无法判断 with LTCMA_PROXY_GAPS and renders no frontier or candidate point, because one research proxy trades on another exchange calendar (SPX misses 39 SSE open days over five years and adds 78 days SSE is closed).
Evidence building raises before the frontier solver runs, so result.frontier stays null and the UI shows only the reason text.
Intersecting dates alone silently turns a period that spans a gap into one 'daily' return, which then gets annualised by 252 and inflates volatility.
trigger_actions: add or change a research proxy whose source trades on a non-SSE calendar
relax or tighten the daily alignment rules in CmaEvidence._proxies, CmaEvidence._product, ReferenceInputs._input_calculation or StrategicAllocationService._validate_daily_risk_axis
change TacticalAllocationData.load_data's strict intersection, period_complete or excluded_dates
change the 252 annualisation basis or the observation count reported to the UI
check_before_edit: Alignment is two rules, not one. common_return_periods intersects the source dates AND keeps only periods that are one adjacent step in every source's own dates; a period that spans a gap for any source is dropped whole. Dropping only by date intersection would annualise multi-day returns as daily.

A trading day missing from every source is a data gap, not a calendar difference: adjacency cannot see it, so LTCMA_PROXY_GAPS / SAA_RISK_GAPPED_DATES / REFERENCE_SSE_CALENDAR_GAP still block it. Only apply that guard when at least one source trades solely on SSE open days, otherwise an all-overseas scope is rejected for Chinese holidays.
The holding path still advances over every common day; only the sample excludes the cross-day periods, so buy_and_hold and monthly rebalancing keep their drift.
Any dropped period must be reported: observations, excluded_return_periods and missing_trading_days travel with the sample and the screening panel renders them.

Before intersecting proxy dates, verify each source covers the requested outer window against the known SSE boundary days. Do not restrict the completeness check to the already shortened intersection. Report source support and require an explicit window change when boundary coverage is unproven; do not invent foreign holiday evidence. Internal cross-calendar intersections remain supported.

LTCMA transition estimation must receive period_contiguous from the retained return intervals on both product and strategic proxy paths. A preceding return end must equal the next start; row adjacency alone is insufficient after filtering. Training counts, regularization validation and complete holdout horizons must honor the mask. Persist the int64 0/1 evidence and hash; keep endpoint states and ordinary return-moment samples unchanged.

Long-term scenario mean-error bootstrap and complete-episode diagnostics must also consume period_contiguous. Estimate lag-one dependence only on connected known-state pairs. For gapped returns, resample disjoint blocks bounded by each continuous segment, retain short tails, normalize by resampled known-row counts and disclose singleton fallback; never fabricate adjacency from retained row positions. Continuous samples retain their circular-block contract; frozen histories are not refitted.

NIW sample-reference NAV dates count the common price axis before cross-day return filtering: observations + excluded_return_periods + 1. Do not display retained daily returns + 1 when gaps split the sample; prior-strength examples still use retained observations only.
safe_observation_methods: python -m pytest tests/test_scope_feasibility.py tests/test_risk_scale_reference.py tests/test_ltcma_evidence.py tests/test_ltcma_statistics.py tests/test_strategic_allocation.py -q
Compare a proxy's dates against SSE open days from data/trade_day_df.parquet before assuming a coverage error is a bug

pitfalls.title: shared_ui_primitive_hides_mascot_from_the_filename_forbidden_zone_check
symptoms: check_frontend_design.mjs reports mascot-in-forbidden-zone 0 while an Allocation/Portfolio/Risk named page really does render the mascot, because the page imports ui.tsx's LoadingPanel instead of Mascot.
The 使用处 list in the same report stops naming the pages that actually show it.
trigger_actions: wrap Mascot in a shared primitive in frontend/src/components/ui.tsx
adopt LoadingPanel or EmptyState on a page whose filename matches the forbidden-zone regex
add a second waiting state to a page that already shows one
check_before_edit: The forbidden-zone rule matches file names, not render trees. Any new shared primitive that renders Mascot must be added to the detection in check_frontend_design.mjs, together with its opt-out prop (mascot={false}), or the mechanical barrier silently stops working.

Exceptions live in MASCOT_LOADING_EXCEPTIONS and must be listed in docs/frontend/README.md 15.3 item 8 at the same time; the exemption only covers LoadingPanel, direct Mascot or a mascot-bearing EmptyState in the same file still counts.

15.3 item 5 allows one mascot per screen. Before adopting LoadingPanel check the other waiting states on that page are mutually exclusive with it; if they can show together, pass mascot={false} on the second one.

A waiting state that sits next to numbers already on screen (a recalculation over a previous result, a panel inside a page that already rendered data) keeps plain text: 15.2 item 1 forbids the mascot beside values.

pitfalls.title: use_allocation_draft_ignores_its_initial_value_when_the_same_key_already_has_a_draft
symptoms: Clicking 「添加投资目标与约束」/「新建研究范围」 opens a form already filled with the previous, unfinished study.
The page's own initializer clearly returns a blank object for the new-entry branch, yet the blank never reaches the screen.
trigger_actions: call useAllocationDraft with a constant scope and express 'start blank' inside the initial-value function
add a new 「新建」 entry link without a per-render token in the URL
strip the fresh token from the URL after mount while the draft key still depends on it
check_before_edit: useAllocationDraft reads localStorage first: decode(stored(key), fresh()) only uses the initial value as a fallback. Identity belongs in the scope key, never in the initializer - that is what the hook's own comment means by 'scope must include the explicit identity'.

A 「新建」 link must carry a token that is recomputed on every render (crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8) in 01, Date.now() in 02); a constant token makes the second click reopen the first click's abandoned draft. A frozen test clock also freezes Date.now(), so a clock-based token is not unique under page.clock.setFixedTime.

Keep the token in the URL while editing, otherwise the key flips on the next render and the stale draft comes back; on save write the confirmed draft to the stable key before switching the URL to ?view=<id>.
The stable key still serves the 'resume the unfinished draft' entry (bare /objectives/new), so do not clear it when a fresh study starts.
safe_observation_methods: rg -n "useAllocationDraft\(" frontend/src   # 每个 scope 是否带身份
浏览器：列表页点「添加」→ 填一半 → 返回列表 → 再点「添加」，第二次必须是空表单

pitfalls.title: a_failed_read_that_falls_back_to_the_empty_state_tells_the_user_there_is_no_data
symptoms: The backend is unreachable, yet the page says 「还没有投资目标与约束」 / 「范围库读取失败；请重试。」 inside an otherwise empty table, so the user goes off to create a record that may already exist.
The failure reason is a single red line far from the content area, or it appears twice - once in the page-level Feedback and once in the panel.
trigger_actions: render a load failure as a bare red line plus the normal empty state
pass a load error into DataTable's `empty` text or into EmptyState
show the same error message both in the page-level Feedback and in the panel that replaces the content
blast_radius: settings catalogues, editors and nested research workspaces
check_before_edit: 整块区域读取失败、且该区域此刻没有别的内容时用 ui.tsx 的 ErrorPanel（居中 error 形象 + 失败原因 + 重试），它与 LoadingPanel 占同一块预留高度、互斥出现；不要把失败塞进 EmptyState 或 DataTable 的 empty 文案里，「还没有数据」会把「没读出来」说成「本来就没有」。
判定条件是「失败且该区域没有内容」（loadFailed / catalogFailed），不是「有 error 就换面板」：同一个 error state 往往同时承载保存、删除、重算这些操作失败，那时业务数值还在屏幕上，按设计准则 15.2 第 1 条只能是纯文字。
换成面板后要把同一条消息从顶部 Feedback 里摘掉（只留 PIT、研究日这类仍然成立的提示），否则一条失败原因出现两次。
ErrorPanel 与 LoadingPanel 都算吉祥物使用处：文件名命中 check_frontend_design.mjs 的 MASCOT_FORBIDDEN 时，必须在 MASCOT_PANEL_EXCEPTIONS 里登记并同步设计准则 15.3 第 8 条，直接用 Mascot 或带形象的 EmptyState 仍然算违规。
error 与 noresult 共用 0011 抓头疑惑姿势，是 15.1 一对一契约里唯一写明的例外（用户 2026-09-23 要求读取失败展示带问号的形象）；换姿势要按 15.3 的 magick 管线替换同名资产，不要改 Mascot.tsx 的状态键或在代码里引用 images/*.png 原图。
设置页的初始读取错误使用 ErrorPanel 默认可读说明与 onRetry，不向用户直出 HTTP/数据库内部报错。业务校验失败仍保留可操作原因；保存、计算失败不得清空草稿或替换已有结果。子页读取不得吞掉异常后再由父 action 宣布加载成功。
safe_observation_methods: rg -n "role=\"alert\"" frontend/src | rg -i "读取|failed|catalog"   # 还有哪些整块读取失败是纯红字
node scripts/check_frontend_design.mjs   # mascot-in-forbidden-zone 必须仍为 0
浏览器：Playwright 里 page.route('**/api/**', r => r.abort('failed'))，看页面中间是否给出形象、原因和重试，且同屏只有 1 个形象

pitfalls.title: ltcma_study_name_uniqueness
symptoms: Two saved LTCMA rows carry the same auto-generated name and cannot be told apart in the center list.
A fixture or test publishes a second LTCMA from the shared definition and fails with CMA_NAME_CONFLICT.
The user renames a study at the confirm step, which clears the preview and forces a full recompute.
trigger_actions: publish, copy or edit an LTCMA version
add or change backend test fixtures that publish more than one LTCMA
change the LTCMA input step layout or study-options payload
blast_radius: backend fixtures that publish several studies in one workspace
LTCMA input-step layout and study-options payload
check_before_edit: Names are unique across versions that are still referable, compared after trimming and case folding; retiring a version releases its name. The check runs inside the governance lock in CmaResearchService.publish and after the idempotent replay, so replays stay historical.
Any fixture publishing more than one LTCMA in a workspace must give each publication its own name; the shared helpers derive it from the idempotency key.

The frontend blocks the preview on a duplicate name using existing_names from /cma/study-options?section=base. That is guidance only; the backend conflict remains the authority. Renaming clears the preview, so never move the check to the confirm step.

pitfalls.title: regime_run_cutoff_must_resolve_pit_before_async_dispatch
symptoms: The header shows a historical PIT date while a regime preview reaches the last date on disk.
trigger_actions: edit historical regime compute routes, preview workers, cutoff controls or frozen result views
blast_radius: regime classification inputs, evaluation targets, saved research cutoff and chart provenance
check_before_edit: Resolve omitted as_of with the shared request context at the API boundary, before starting a thread; worker ContextVars do not carry per-tab overrides. Preserve explicit per-run dates and explicit PIT-off behavior; unreadable settings must fail rather than read all data.
Use the effective cutoff for full and node previews, saved runs, research version activation and parameter experiments. Compare actual output dates, not only request payloads or chart bounds.
Keep frozen results immutable and show their original cutoff alongside the current PIT when different. Cropping a retrospective all-data result does not make it a historical-cutoff calculation.

pitfalls.title: pre_investment_version_state_must_come_from_shared_versioning_module
symptoms: A list lets users select an artifact whose objective or scope was revised, and SAA or TAA rejects it only after clicking next.
Two lists disagree on whether the same upstream version is current.
trigger_actions: edit list endpoints, selection gates or edit flows for mandates, scopes, LTCMA, SAA, TAA or research packages
blast_radius: all pre-investment list pages and SAA/TAA/package entry gates
check_before_edit: Derive version/upstream/usable through ResearchVersions instead of new supersedes scans.

Superseded remains a historical version identity. Retiring the series head must propagate blocked usability to older versions and all dependants; a superseded ref with no latest_id is not upgradeable. Scope equivalence requires matching economic fingerprints AND canonical weight limits; compare frozen definitions at read time without changing old hashes.
NIW prior menus and restored selections must honor usable.status before numerical compatibility checks. A stale or blocked prior must not be offered as selectable merely because retired is false.
safe_observation_methods: Run backend/tests/test_cma_upstream_group.py and the SaaCenter / LtcmaCenter vitest suites.

pitfalls.title: standalone_agent_requires_host_owned_business_authority_and_durable_operation_identity
symptoms: A supposedly portable module imports parent research services or UI assets.
A cancelled HTTP wait is mistaken for completed remote work.
Provider call IDs reused in another assistant batch replay an unrelated receipt.
UI approvals or old responses target a different run/context.
trigger_actions: change standalone agent runtime, authentication or HTTP tool contract
change widget recovery, cancellation or host callbacks
claim standalone migration complete
check_before_edit: Export/install the module outside the parent source import path; do not certify independence from directory layout alone.
Use official persistent graph checkpoints with synchronous durability; approval nonce, frozen arguments and one human decision must survive restart.
Scope tool receipt identity by run and assistant batch as well as provider call ID. Persist host receipts before returning results to the graph.
Stopping blocks new dispatch. Already dispatched work retains ownership until final acknowledgment; timeout/5xx/invalid response remain uncertain. Replay only the same host idempotency key.

Use separate application issuer keys; never give the master data-directory key to a host. Sign app/user/scopes server-side; recheck ownership on reads, streams, decisions and recovery. Model keys are write-only and encrypted, and endpoint changes require a newly supplied key.
Freeze API destination and request identity before asynchronous credential lookup; late browser responses cannot replace another context or newer state.
Only approved model projections enter the LLM; full artifacts are read separately by their owner. Host data policy checks messages including system/context and declared tools.
Offline SDK and demo browsers do not certify full investment/PIT/save-rule migration or real model quality.

The historical portable prototype had one model profile, plain text and finite session limits. The independent v2 candidate adds profiles, memory, compaction and handoff; verify each behavior from its own tests, not the old in-tree prototype.

Current host authority lives in research_access and integrations/portable_agent. Do not route business tools back through backend/agent. Check release metadata and component manifest on reconnect; an incompatible release disables the assistant while preserving the original request identity.

Preserve Dev saved-algorithm lookup/read and frozen page mode/date contracts. AI graph proposals cannot replace study identity or manufacture validation qualification; the editor merges authored fields and invalidates prior qualification.
Long offline endurance probes must renew expiring test credentials as the SDK does; an expired token is not a leaked execution task.
After Dev integration, preserve the research study identity and causal/realtime gate when filling a scenario candidate; saved-definition read must use the requested revision.
A business process killed after atomic creation can reconcile by operation_id; an absent write receipt stays fenced as COMMIT_UNCERTAIN instead of retrying a new write.

page.read contains projected JSON text: verify the entire signed receipt and ownership first, then exempt only result.content from the free-text heuristic. Never admit unsigned/tampered page content; test the actual model admission path, not only the tool output.
Manual-event workbench contexts must use page global-events with workspace events; hidden event-library assistants remain inactive.

Known ResearchError failures for read tools and deterministic pre-dispatch validation/missing-evidence errors are terminal failed and release the stable page scope, including preview-class tools. Unknown remains reserved for unconfirmed dispatched work; verify subsequent calls after recovery.
Claim accepted operations and honor pre-dispatch cancellation in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. A cancelled operation must never transition back to running.

Finalize cancellation checks, authoring/preview/scenario persistence and the terminal operation state in one SQLite transaction. A committed cancellation prevents artifacts; completion-first cancellation observes the completed result. Roll back partial artifacts on failure.

Unchanged read-only handlers must not advance authoring revision or invalidate an existing save confirmation. Persist actual domain-state changes or new previews; progress labels alone are not a mutation test because product search records candidates.

A partial permission revocation invalidates the whole frozen context, including signed history, model input/output checks and memory. Require every recorded tool permission; obtain a newly registered context for retained permissions. Archive imports must obtain assigned-owner scopes through the existing live authority; never synthesize wildcard grants from archive identity.

Persist the source archive hash before importing records. Interrupted imports must reconcile deterministic initial/final authoring states and identical scenario artifacts; changed archives or object contents are conflicts, not overwrite permission. Reuse the owned context persisted with the first imported authoring, preserving frozen PIT/catalog/data when the environment changes before retry. Scenario catalog fingerprints must include mutable definition/event/release metadata and research-source active manifests/indicator versions, so stale signed results and in-flight model receipts are rejected. Convert invalid release-catalog dates and domain rejections to controlled ResearchError responses in the shared version entry point. Unreadable/corrupt manifests, missing snapshot targets and scenario catalog storage failures must return controlled 503 responses during both registration and admission; never replace unverifiable catalogs with empty or cached evidence. Test interruption after multiple session writes and rebuild completed output files in a new directory.
safe_observation_methods: env PYTHONPATH=.:backend python3 -m pytest backend/tests/test_portable_agent_host.py backend/tests/test_portable_scenarios.py -q
